title: SelfTestApp — programmatic 14-step Phase 0 probe
why: tools/bringup-checklist.md is paper. Make it an on-device app that probes display/keyboard/SD/WiFi/BLE/IR/IMU/mic/speaker/NTP/CC1101/nRF24 and renders pass/fail per step with diagnostics. Operator opens app once instead of walking 14 manual steps.
acceptance_software: app appears in System category
each probe returns 0/1/2 (pass/skip/fail) without crashing on missing hardware
native + device builds clean
acceptance_bench: Run app on hardware, all 14 probes match the manual checklist outcomes

title: Boot self-test mode (NVS flag system.boot_selftest)
why: Useful for kiosk / production-test flashing — burn a board, plug it in, see green/red within 5s without touching a key. Gates SelfTestApp to run before the launcher when the flag is set.
acceptance_software: Settings row toggles flag
main.cpp runs self-test before launcher when flag set
native build clean
acceptance_bench: Reboot with flag set → 14-row pass/fail screen renders inside ~5s

title: BbLinkProbeApp — diagnostic for islandmagic/bb-link bridge
why: Track A apps (Kenwood/APRS/RemoteHead) need bb-link. Today there's no way to confirm the bridge is paired and serving the GATT service short of opening one of those apps. Probe app does: BT scan for 'B.B. Link' name → BLE connect → GATT service walk → report.
acceptance_software: app uses IBleCentral abstraction
reports each phase: scan/connect/gatt-walk with pass/fail
native test with FakeBleCentral covers all three phases
acceptance_bench: With bb-link powered + paired: app reports 'BridgeReady'; without bb-link: 'NotFound' inside 10s

title: On-device soak watchdog — heap+uptime+panic logger
why: tools/soak-monitor.py reads serial; complementary on-device path writes a CSV every 60s to /soak/<boot_ts>.csv with (uptime_ms, free_heap, max_block, last_panic_reason). Crash-resilient — file is opened append, fsynced after each row. soak-monitor.py reads it after 24h.
acceptance_software: SoakLog appends one CSV row per minute
FakeFs-based test verifies row format + append semantics
soak-monitor.py grows a --read-soak-csv flag
acceptance_bench: Run for 1h on device → /soak/<ts>.csv has ~60 rows; soak-monitor.py reports clean trend

title: nRF24 RPD-bit promiscuous mode — direct register write
why: RadioLib doesn't expose RPD; Bastille's Mousejack technique requires direct write to register 0x09 (RPD) read after a brief listen. Implement INrf24::set_promiscuous(true) to actually toggle the bit on Esp32Nrf24, with a register read-back assertion. Native fake stays as-is.
acceptance_software: promiscuous flag plumbs through INrf24
native fake records calls + reports state
ESP32 path writes 0x09 RPD bit + reads back to confirm
acceptance_bench: With nRF24 cap: MousejackApp scan finds devices the user has not pre-paired (real promiscuous capture)

title: Edge-toggle async sub-GHz TX — bit-bang GDO0 with absolute deadlines
why: Replay's current packet-mode TX works for fixed-code remotes but not Flipper-perfect rolling-code timing. Implement Cc1101Radio::transmit_raw_edges() to bit-bang GDO0 directly with esp_timer_get_time() absolute-deadline scheduling per edge.
acceptance_software: transmit_raw_edges signature unchanged from native fake
ESP32 impl uses gpio_set_level + esp_timer_get_time loop
native test asserts edge ordering + count preserved
acceptance_bench: Capture a garage remote, replay it, confirm garage opens (jitter <10us per edge)

title: CC1101 GDO IRQ wiring + Jammer Protocol mode
why: Phase 4.x+ promised SubGhzJammer Protocol/Reactive modes; both need GDO0 IRQ on packet/preamble detect. Wire the GPIO ISR registration in Cc1101Radio, expose ICc1101::on_packet_irq(callback). Add Protocol mode to SubGhzJammerApp that fires CW for 100ms when preamble detected.
acceptance_software: on_packet_irq plumbs through ICc1101
SubGhzJammerApp Protocol mode wires the callback
native test simulates IRQ + asserts CW activation
acceptance_bench: With CC1101 cap: jam selectively fires only when target preamble seen

title: SubGhzScan smarter dwell — configurable window + averaging
why: Current 1-sample/tick misses transient signals. Add per-channel dwell parameter (default 5ms) and rolling average over N samples; auto-tune mode increases dwell on quiet bands and decreases on noisy ones.
acceptance_software: dwell_ms accessor + setter
auto_tune flag clamps dwell to [1, 50] ms
native test verifies averaging + clamp
acceptance_bench: Sweep a known-noisy band, confirm peak channels are visible without flicker
